_purpose: What a filing shows about a record whose models read no usable development figure, or whose figure the filing's own pages show to be no development of reserves the syndicate held (the review of 2 October 2026, P-10). run_analysis.py (load_and_classify, load_filing_eligibility) reads it. kind 'first_year_nil_opening': a first-year report whose opening reserves are nil on the syndicate's own balance sheet; the loader counts it with the first-year reports the extraction skips, and missingness_check.py classifies it as structural. The kind does not say the book has no mature underwriting year: 1254/2022 and 6118/2014 hold mature years by an inwards RITC or a quota share, so each entry's reason and decision say why that record has no eligible outcome. kind 'stated_basis_excluded': the filing states the prior-year movement on a basis the paper excludes (basis 'net' or 'unknown'; the settled net-basis rule, D-9) and no model read a figure; the loader records that basis, so the record is a basis exclusion. Each entry needs two readings of the filing, the pages read and a quote, as the other registers do; an entry marked _to_complete is skipped, and the run log names it, until it carries them. source_file and source_sha256 name the filing the pages were read in.
_status: Completed by the stage-3 PC page check of 5 October 2026 (page images and text layer, each page read by eye): the three entries the review of 2 October 2026 recorded ahead of their readings (agents/R5.md, R5-F1 and its second pass) each carry their pages, quote, file hash and two readings, and none is marked _to_complete. 435/2014's basis is 'unknown' (unstated): 'net release' names the total of two class releases (42,433 + 56,123 = 98,556) and the note never says gross or net of reinsurance; the exclusion holds either way under D-9. 1254/2022 is kept as first_year_nil_opening by the owner's decision of 5 October 2026, its reason restated.

1254_2022.decision: owner's decision, 5 October 2026 (option A of the stage-3 PC page check): keep the record as first_year_nil_opening. The syndicate's opening claims outstanding are nil (p41), so the record has no development of reserves the syndicate held. Its reserves arrived by an inwards RITC of Syndicate 2689's 2017, 2018 and 2019 years of account with effect from 1 January 2022 (p41), and the only printed development, -28.229 gross on p30, is the cedant's estimate measured against the RITC value, which conflicts with the syndicate's own net release of 4.7m (p7). The kind's earlier premise, no underwriting year up to t-2, does not hold for this record: the book holds mature years, by the RITC. It is not registered as a take-on with a confirmed figure, as 1884/2021 is.
